snippet.title: Dicey Bizniz: Dice Roguelike Deckbuilder - Trailer #2
snippet.description:
Dicey Bizniz is almost here! This brand-new teaser trailer shows the huge progress since our first reveal. The game is nearly complete, only Boss Battles remain before launch. Get ready to roll the dice in a roguelike adventure full of strategy, combos, and satisfying visuals.

🎲 Features:
• Strategic dice-based roguelike gameplay
• Shops, relics, spells, and synergies to discover
• Gorgeous hand-crafted effects and animations
• Achievements and full Steam integration
• Built with Godot Engine by a solo indie developer

Wishlist on Steam now and stay tuned for the full release!

#DiceyBizniz #IndieGame #DiceGame #Roguelike #GodotEngine #SteamGaming #IndieDev #GameTrailer
